verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is an immigration law firm, so the International Entrepreneur Rule is a fair question to ask of it. Its entrepreneur blog and service list cover E-2, B-1-in-contemplation-of-E-2, O-1, L-1, H-1B and EB-1, but none of them mention International Entrepreneur Rule parole or its qualifying-investment thresholds. With no evidence for an applicable pathway, the verdict is none.
